dialogue.content: こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いします。まだカウンセラー役をあまりしたことなくご迷惑おかけしますが、率直な評価をお聞かせ下さい。21時になったら始めます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for being here today. I haven't played the role of a counselor much, so I apologize for any inconvenience, but please give me your honest feedback. We'll start at 9 p.m. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。こちらこそよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Good evening. The pleasure is all mine. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ご相談ありがとうございます。相談員につなぎますのではじめに年齢と、性別を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out. I'll connect you to a counselor, so to start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 16歳女
dialogue.English: 16, female.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださってありがとうございます。相談内容教えてもらってもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. Could you tell me what you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 学校行きたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: 学校行きたくないんだね！16歳だったら高校生1年生ですか？
dialogue.English: I see, you don't want to go to school. At 16, are you in your first year of high school?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: もしよかったら高校に行きたくない理由聞いてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: If you're comfortable sharing, may I ask why you don't want to go to high school?

dialogue.content: みんなに無視されてる
dialogue.English: Everyone is ignoring me.

dialogue.content: 無視・・・。それは辛いですよね。みんなから無視される理由って心当たりありますか？話せる範囲でいいので教えてくれますか？
dialogue.English: Being ignored... That must be very painful. Do you have any idea why everyone might be ignoring you? Please tell me, but only what you're comfortable sharing.

dialogue.content: わかんない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 急に無視された
dialogue.English: They just suddenly started ignoring me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・。では、本当につい最近の事なんですね！
dialogue.English: I see... so this just happened very recently!

dialogue.content: つい最近ってわけじゃない
dialogue.English: Not exactly recently.

dialogue.content: いきなり無視されたの
dialogue.English: It just started out of nowhere.

dialogue.content: 何ヶ月か前に
dialogue.English: A few months ago.

dialogue.content: すみません。そうなんですね数か月前に急に学校に行ったらみんなからの無視が始まったんですね
dialogue.English: I'm sorry. I see. So a few months ago, everyone at school suddenly started ignoring you.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: では、今はお友達は１人もいないのかな？
dialogue.English: So, does that mean you don't have any friends at all right now?

dialogue.content: わたしはみんな友達だと思ってるけど
dialogue.English: Well, I think of them as my friends,

dialogue.content: みんながわたしを友達と思ってないのかも
dialogue.English: but maybe they don't think of me as a friend.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。ちなみにこのことを相談したお友達はいるかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you talked to any of your friends about this?

dialogue.content: いない
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: だってみんな無視してくるから
dialogue.English: Because everyone's ignoring me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・ではお友達と思っている子にも無視されているという事なんですね・・。
dialogue.English: I see... so that means even the people you consider friends are ignoring you.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・・。それは学校に行きたくなくなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see... That would make anyone not want to go to school.

dialogue.content: うんつまんないの
dialogue.English: Yeah, it's no fun.

dialogue.content: つまんないですよね。学校の休み時間とかは何しているのかな？
dialogue.English: I can imagine it's no fun. What do you do during breaks at school?

dialogue.content: 教室でひとりでボーっとしてる
dialogue.English: I just space out by myself in the classroom.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ・・・つまんなよね。でも急に無視が始まったという事は何かあったと思うんだけど、小さなことでもいいから何か思い出せないかな？
dialogue.English: I see... that must be boring. But since it started so suddenly, I feel like something must have happened. Can you recall anything, even if it seems small?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: わたしなんかしたのかなぁ
dialogue.English: I wonder if I did something...

dialogue.content: そっかぁ・・・本当に心当たりがないんだね。教えてくれてありがとうこの状況を先生とかお母さんとか誰か大人に相談したことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see... so you really can't think of anything. Thank you for telling me. Have you talked to any adults about this situation, like a teacher or your mother?

dialogue.content: ない
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: 心配かけたくないから
dialogue.English: Because I don't want to make them worry.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。心配かけたくないから今1人で頑張っているんだね！
dialogue.English: I see. You don't want to worry them, so you've been trying to handle this on your own.

dialogue.content: 我慢してる
dialogue.English: I'm enduring it.

dialogue.content: でもずっと我慢しているとずーみんさんも辛いから、この状況から抜け出す事に一緒に考えていきたいと思うんだけど・・・
dialogue.English: But it must be hard for you to keep enduring this, so I'd like to think together with you about how we can get you out of this situation...

dialogue.content: 無視が始まってから今までお友達と１度もお話ししていないの？
dialogue.English: Since the ignoring started, have you not talked to your friends at all?

dialogue.content: 話してない
dialogue.English: I haven't.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。ずっと我慢し続けているんだね。えらいね。学校の外のお友達とかはいるのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. You've been enduring this all this time. You've been very strong. Do you have any friends outside of school?

dialogue.content: 他のクラスには友達いるよ。あと彼氏
dialogue.English: I have friends in other classes. And a boyfriend.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。他のお友達や彼氏がいるんだね。では、この話を相談したことあるかな？
dialogue.English: I see, so you have other friends and a boyfriend. Have you talked to them about this?

dialogue.content: ない
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: そっか・・・。それはどうしてかな？よかったら教えてくれますか？
dialogue.English: I see... Why is that, if you don't mind me asking?

dialogue.content: だって恥ずかしいじゃん
dialogue.English: 'Cause it's embarrassing.

dialogue.content: 無視されてるとかバレたくないし
dialogue.English: And I don't want them to find out I'm being ignored.

dialogue.content: 恥ずかしいんですね・・・。たとえば、相談できる友達に話したらどんな事言われそうかな？
dialogue.English: So you feel embarrassed... For example, if you did talk to a friend you can confide in, what do you imagine they would say?

dialogue.content: ほっとけばって言うかも
dialogue.English: They might just tell me to ignore them.

dialogue.content: そっか・・・彼氏さんにいってもそんな反応かな？
dialogue.English: I see... Do you think your boyfriend would react the same way?

dialogue.content: 彼氏には絶対相談したくない！！！
dialogue.English: I absolutely do not want to talk to my boyfriend about it!!!

dialogue.content: そうだよね・・・彼氏さんは一緒の学校なの？
dialogue.English: I understand... Does your boyfriend go to the same school?

dialogue.content: 一緒だよ。違うクラスなの
dialogue.English: Yeah, same school. Different class.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとうじゃ、誰にも相談できない状況なんだね・・・
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me. So it feels like there's no one you can talk to about this...

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: ずーみんさんがこれからずっと我慢して学生生活を送るのは相談員は心配です。クラスメートの友達とか話しかけれそうな人はいないのかな？
dialogue.English: I'm worried about you having to endure this throughout your school life. Is there anyone among your classmates you feel you could talk to?

dialogue.content: 男子とは普通に話す
dialogue.English: I talk to the boys normally.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ・・・。よかったです。クラスメートで話せる人がいてでは男子とかには、この状況の事何か聞いたことはない？
dialogue.English: I see... I'm glad to hear there's someone in your class you can talk with. Have you ever asked any of the boys about what's going on?

dialogue.content: お前可愛いからヤキモチ妬かれてんだろって言われたことはある
dialogue.English: One of them once told me, "It's probably because you're cute and they're jealous of you."

dialogue.content: そっかそっか、可愛いんだね！なんかヤキモチ妬かれた事とか心当たりないかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Can you think of any reason why people might be jealous of you?

dialogue.content: 男子によく話しかけられる
dialogue.English: Boys talk to me a lot.

dialogue.content: 男子にモテるんだね。
dialogue.English: So you're popular with boys.

dialogue.content: モテるって言うか、普通に話してるだけ
dialogue.English: I wouldn't say I'm popular; I'm just talking to them normally.

dialogue.content: ずーみんさんは普通に話しているだけなんだよね
dialogue.English: From your perspective, you're just talking normally, right?

dialogue.content: これからずーみんさんは学校生活どうやって過ごしていきたいかな？
dialogue.English: Looking ahead, how would you like your school life to be?

dialogue.content: 学校行くのやめよっかなって思ってる
dialogue.English: I'm thinking about quitting school.

dialogue.content: そうだんだ・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 春になったらクラス替えするじゃん
dialogue.English: They change classes in the spring, right?

dialogue.content: それまで休みたい
dialogue.English: I want to stay home until then.

dialogue.content: そうだね！あと少しだから休むのもいいかもねでも休むには先生や親に話さないといけないけど大丈夫？
dialogue.English: That's true. It's only for a little while longer, so taking a break could be an option. But to do that, you would need to talk to your teachers or parents. Are you okay with that?

dialogue.content: 体調不良とか言っとけばいいかなーって。でも彼氏に心配かけるのは嫌だなー
dialogue.English: I was thinking I could just say I'm not feeling well. But I don't want to make my boyfriend worry.

dialogue.content: そうだよね。心配するよね・・・。信頼できる大人に一度そうだんしてみるのはどう？担任の先生とか保健の先生、スクールカウンセラーとか・・・
dialogue.English: That's true, he would worry... How about trying to talk to an adult you can trust, like your homeroom teacher, the school nurse, or a school counselor?

dialogue.content: 大人って信頼出来なくない？
dialogue.English: But can you really trust adults?

dialogue.content: 助けてくれなさそうだし
dialogue.English: It doesn't seem like they'd help.

dialogue.content: だからここで相談きたんだよ
dialogue.English: That's why I came here to talk.

dialogue.content: そうだよね・・・
dialogue.English: I understand...

dialogue.content: お母さんとかお父さんも信頼できない？
dialogue.English: Do you feel you can't trust your mother or father either?

dialogue.content: 親は心配するから詳しくは言いたくない
dialogue.English: My parents would worry, so I don't want to tell them the details.

dialogue.content: たとえば親に相談したらどう答えが返ってくると思う？
dialogue.English: For example, if you were to talk to your parents, what kind of response do you think you would get?

dialogue.content: すみません、時間ですね・・・クロージングまで出来ませんでした・・・
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, it looks like our time is up... We weren't able to get to the closing.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: 失礼します
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: またロールプレイ評価あげます
dialogue.English: I'll give you feedback on the role-play later.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: I appreciate it.

dialogue.content: システム終了ボタン押してくださって結構ですよ
dialogue.English: You can go ahead and press the system end button.

dialogue.content: はい！お先に失礼します
dialogue.English: Okay! I'll be leaving first, then.
